translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Mateo' pilla Diosa' mika ura kuinda

content: Dyabulu, Jesúsnuujcha lawaanu kemi.
Jesúsnu Dyabulu ujcha lawaanu ke'keesa tyatu, Espíritu Santo bene Jesúsnu tiba den chutyuin tenasha miya' jiimi.
Tsenñu Jesús 40 malu, 40 kepe panda fajtu puitu, umaa panda mutyami.
Tsenñu Dyabulu ujcha lawaanu tya' mitya kalen jitu tsandimi: Ñu uwain Diosa' Natuya, entsa shupukanu pan tiyade tide, timi.
Tsandiñu Jesús pakatu tsandimi: Diosa' Kiikanu entsa pillave: Chachilla panda findun chunanu dejutyuve, naa Diosa' pañu ya' fi'pakisha faamu palaachi bain chunuu dejuve,
tive, timi.
Tsenñu Dyabulu, Jesúsnu Dioschin juu jumu pebulu Jerusalénshaa bene miya' jimi. Tsejtu aa elesha mishbui'sha kayu katyu tenabi miya' lu-i' uikaatu,

tsandimi: Ñu uwain Diosa' Natuya tusha yanbude, matyu Diosa' Kiikanuya entsandive: Dios ya' anjeelanu ñunu washkekaanu eenu tsuve, tsenmala ñunu anjeela yallachi jiinu detsuve, ñu' neepa tusha tyuika' shupukachi tapan jutyu,
ti' pillave, timi.
Tsandiñu Jesús bain tsandimi: Diosa' Kiikanu entsa bain tsandive: Ñu' Bale Ruku Diosnuya ti ken tsangue tirenu kityude,
ti' pillave, timi.
Tsejtu pulla'bi Dyabulu Jesúsnu aa kuyisha miya' luitu, tu kuraa, tsenmin naa tiba uukeraa jumu dekeewaatu,
tsandimi: Kumuinchi entsa keewarekeeshu juntsa ñunu dekuwanu tsuyu, ñu in ajuusha teledi', inu aawa kureshu juntsaa, timi.
Tsenñu Jesús tsandimi: ¡Manbaka' mijiide, Satanás! matyu Diosa' Kiikanu tsandive: Ñu' Bale Ruku Diosnuren aawa kure' keewaake', yachiren tiba kiikemu juude,
ti' pillave, timi.
Tsenñu Dyabulu manbaka' miiñu, mantsa anjee deji' Jesúsnu washkentsula.
Jesús Galileashamijakares nenu peepumi.
Juannu peesu depuñu kuinda mijatu, Jesús Galilea tusha miimi.
Tsejturen Nazaretnu chui'mujchi Cafarnaúmsha, aa pusu keebi chumu kaa pebulunaa chuimi, naa Zabulónnu sera' jimu paandela bain, naa Neftalínu sera' jimu paandela bain chunu tusha.
Tsaaren entsaa puimiya, Diosa' mitya pamu Isaías entsainu tsuve ti' pamuwaañu tsaa puitaa tsaimi:

content.text: Jordán pi bejkusha, pajvinu pasha jumu tu,
matyu lamaa pi keesha jumu tu,
ñu, Galilea, judío chachi jutyula' chunu tu:
Matyu jelekenu uu jeetyannainsha chunañunamula' jungaba

content: Jesús juntsai' Cafarnaúmsha ji' chutu: Diosnu rei juu tananu malu kalenave; veta' pensa demangue' Diosnu meenguidei, ti' kuinda mijakares neneimi.
Jesús ainguemu rukulanutaapallu mikami.
Jesús Galilea aa pusu pi keetala nendu pai naatala katami, mainya Simón, tsandityu'ba, Pedro tinu ruku; tsenmala kamainya Andrés mumu. Yala ainguemu de' mitya, ataaya pisha tya'kikendetsu katami.
Tsejtu Jesús tsandimi: In bendala jadei, tsenmala iya ñullanu, chachillanaa alla kan tsanguemu ruku detirenu tsuyu, timi.
Tsandinmalan yala' ataaya junu deshuike', ya' disipulu tiyanu ya' bendaa jila.
Tsejtu kayu ajkesha jindu kama pai naatala, matyu Zebedeo' nalanu bain katami: Santiagonu bain, Juannu bain. Tsenñu yala ya' apaba kaa baakusha waaku ura' kikendetsuren, Jesús yalanu mikañu,
yala' apanu bain, naa yala' kaa baaku bain deshuike', ya' bendala jei jila ya' disipulu tiyanu.
Jesús mijakare' dilulanuura' mandiremi.

Jesús chachi waku wakudinu yatala mijakare' pas nendu kumuinchi Galilea deneintsumi, Diosnu rei juu tananu mika ura kuinda mijakares nendu. Tsejtu ti diipeya juu tadeeñu bain, naa ti kiyanchi dilu deeñu bain ura' mandires neneintsumi.

Tsenñu kumuinchi Siria tusha, Jesús naakes nentsuñuba kuinda demijatu, matyu ne tichi diluju' llakinguen dechu'ba, junu detajiñu, naa ne diipeyachi juu, ne kiyanchi juu, naa dyabulu puu chumulanu bain, naa des-iimulanu bain, naa dedeelaa chumulanu bain taji tajideiñu, Jesús ura' mandire' me-ee-eekemi.
Tsenñu Galileasha chumula bain, Decápolissha chumula bain, naa Jerusalénsha chumula bain, naa Judeasha chumula bain, naa Jordán pi pajlanu pasha chumula bain, pure' chachi Jesúsnu sure neneintsula.
